title: First even moment from the second moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $P$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $r\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $r>0$. If the expectation of $X^2$ under $P$ is $1$, then the expectation of $X^{2\cdot 1}$ under $P$ equals $\frac{(2r-1)r}{\binom{2r}{2}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
